title: Fattoush Salad
description: Fattoush Salad is a traditional Arabic salad made with fresh vegetables, herbs, and crispy toasted pita bread, all tossed in a tangy sumac and pomegranate molasses dressing. It is refreshing, crunchy, and vibrant, commonly served as part of a mezze spread.

ingredients.title: For the Salad
items: 2 cups romaine lettuce, washed and torn into bite-sized pieces
1 cup arugula (optional, for a peppery touch)
¼ cup fresh mint leaves, chopped
2–3 pita breads (preferably day-old), cut into triangles

ingredients.title: For the Dressing
items: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instruction.title: Instructions
steps:
1. Prepare the Pita Chips:
• Preheat oven to 180°C / 350°F.
• Toss pita triangles with olive oil and a pinch of salt.
• Spread on a baking sheet and bake for 8–12 minutes until golden and crispy.
• Optional: sprinkle sumac before baking for extra flavor.

2. Prepare the Vegetables:
• Wash and dry all greens thoroughly.
• Dice cucumbers, tomatoes, and bell peppers uniformly.
• Slice radishes and green onions thinly.
• Chop parsley and mint finely.

3. Make the Dressing:
• Whisk olive oil, pomegranate molasses, lemon juice, vinegar, garlic, sumac, salt, pepper, and honey until emulsified.
• Taste and adjust balance to ensure tangy-sweet flavor.

4. Assemble the Salad:
• Combine all vegetables and herbs in a large bowl.
• Add two-thirds of the dressing and toss gently.
• Add crispy pita chips just before serving to keep them crunchy.
• Sprinkle extra sumac on top.

5. Plating:
• Serve in a wide shallow bowl.
• Top with pita chips for texture and height.
• Garnish with mint and a light drizzle of pomegranate molasses.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve as part of a mezze platter with hummus and baba ghanoush
Pair with grilled meats or kebabs
Enjoy as a light standalone meal

chefTips: Add pita chips only at the last moment to maintain crunch.
Use fresh herbs generously for authentic flavor and aroma.
Sumac is essential for traditional tangy flavor—do not skip.
Balance pomegranate molasses carefully for sweet-tart depth.
